name: Tiddy Mun

attributes.attribute: a gentle spirit of the English fens
cared for those who tended the land

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tiddy Mun is a gentle spirit of the fens of England. His name seems to mean tidy man. He was a white-haired, kindly soul who cared for those who tended the land. When the fen waters rose he was asked to harm no one. The draining of the fens took away his home.

okr.objective: Set down Tiddy Mun as the gentle spirit of the English fens.
key_results: Names him a white-haired kind spirit
Notes the call for him to help in storm
States the fens were drained and he lost his home
